# Project plan

## Start-up phase

The project will begin by organizing the existing MVP code and defining the development and testing environment for the funded phase. The initial work will include establishing the project structure, confirming the required R/Shiny dependencies, configuring testthat and shinytest2, and defining the datasets and test scenarios to be used throughout the project.

## Technical delivery

The funded work will be carried out over six months, organized into two three-month stages. Each stage will build on the results of the previous one: first, the current MVP will be stabilized and organized; subsequently, its existing functionalities will be strengthened.

Table 2. Activity and Deliverable Timeline
| **Stage** | **Months** | **Main Activities** | **Results / Deliverables** |
|---|---|---|---|
| **1. Stabilization and Preparation** | **1–3** | Optimize the workflows of the current MVP, strengthen code organization, configure testing with `testthat` and `shinytest2`, define datasets and test scenarios, and implement priority adjustments. | Stabilized MVP, consolidated modular structure, reproducible environment, and defined test scenarios, with initial adjustments implemented. |
| **2. Strengthening and Improvements** | **4–6** | Strengthen existing functionalities, imputation options, diagnostics, model evaluation, results, and visualizations; expand testing and verification. | Strengthened functionalities, improved diagnostics and visualizations, expanded testing, and documented verification results. |

## Other aspects

The project's code and development resources will be maintained in a public repository to support reuse and future contributions. An open-source license will be defined for the consolidated project. Public dissemination will be considered as part of the subsequent consolidation phase, including publication of project results and communication through R Consortium channels when appropriate.

Table 3. Funded Work by Stage.

| **Stage** | **Months** | **Main Work** | **Hours** | **Requested Funds** |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|
| **1. Stabilization and Preparation** | 1–3 | MVP workflow stabilization, code organization, testing setup, datasets and test scenarios, priority adjustments. | **140** | **US$4,200** |
| **2. Strengthening and Improvements** | 4–6 | Strengthening existing functionalities, imputation, diagnostics, model evaluation, results, visualizations, testing and statistical verification. | **193** | **US$5,790** |
